authorization_scope: Future Stage 3 Part B only; no model executes in Stage 3B
mandatory_limitation: Public NBA game-level minute displays and the archived game records agreed at the available whole-second resolution in the audited sample, while small discrepancies remained between summed game displays and NBA season-level decimal minute displays. Because season-level MIN was not the scientific outcome, exposure, or primary model predictor, and because shooting counts and analytical eligibility reconciled, the amended prospective validation protocol treated season-total MIN as an ancillary representation field rather than an exact numerical release gate. The internal NBA aggregation mechanism remains unknown.
